intro: Get your local forecast or add a city.
privacy: Location is requested only when you choose it. Rounded coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for the forecast. No ads or our own analytics.
noResults: No cities found. Try a different name.
network: Cannot reach the weather service. Check your connection.
timeout: The service did not respond in time. Try again.
invalid: The service returned an incomplete forecast.
denied: Location permission was denied. You can add a city instead.
geoError: Could not find your location. Try near a window or add a city.
geoTimeout: Location lookup timed out. You can add a city instead.
limit: You can save up to 10 cities. Remove one first.
aboutBody:
Refresh Weather 1.0.1
An independent KaiOS Refresh app by Atlas Messenger. Not affiliated with KaiOS Technologies or Google.
credits: Forecast: Open-Meteo, CC BY 4.0. City search: GeoNames via Open-Meteo. The free service is for non-commercial use. Icons: Google, set-6 from mrdarrengriffin/google-weather-icons; all icon rights belong to Google.
privacyDetail: Cities and the last forecast are stored on this phone. GPS coordinates are rounded to 0.01°. Requests run only while the app is open. Open-Meteo receives your IP and coordinates; its policy deletes server logs within 90 days. City search sends the typed city name to Open-Meteo/GeoNames. If the direct endpoint is unavailable, the forecast uses our Cloudflare fallback server, which also receives your IP and rounded coordinates.
badCoordinates: Enter latitude −90 to 90 and longitude −180 to 180, separated by a comma.
fallback: Direct request unavailable. Trying the backup server…
